newsitem.title: USA: Lufthansa cargo traffic at JFK up 14.7pct.
newsitem.headline: Lufthansa cargo traffic at JFK up 14.7pct.

text.p: Lufthansa handled 10,788 tonnes of inbound and outbound cargo at New York's John F. Kennedy Airport during June, up 14.7 percent on the 9,408 tonnes handled in same month a year ago, a spokesman for the carrier told Reuters.

The increase of the carrier's commercial traffic at JFK reflects the seven extra weekly Boeing 747-Freighter flights it began operating on March 30, bringing its freighter ex-JFK service to 17 weekly flights.
As part of its summer schedule, the company began using its JFK operations as a transit hub for its "sunbelt" destinations; Atlanta, Dallas/Fort Worth and Miami.
The company's summer schedule terminates on October 25, however, it will continue to use New York as one of its four main U.S. gateways, the company spokesman said.

Plans to increase or decrease freighter service to and from NY are not known at this time, "that will be based on seasonal demands," the company official stated. - Reuters Air Cargo Service Tel+ 44 171 542 7706 Fax +5017 - www.racs.com
